title: notanthera sarmentosus
intro: Notanthera sarmentosus, commonly known as yellow passion flower, is a perennial vine native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Notanthera sarmentosus include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, further contributing to its therapeutic potential.
